name: Sudan
value: RSF drones kill 14–19 in Blue Nile 24 Nov
summary: RSF drone strikes kill 14 to 19 civilians in Damazin and Roseires on 24 Nov; the UN condemned the attacks on 25 Nov
state: Drone strikes on Damazin and Roseires in Blue Nile State on 24 Nov killed at least 14 civilians according to Sudan Tribune, or 19 according to a rights group, with both reports blaming the RSF (Sudan Tribune; Rio Times). The UN condemned the strikes on 25 Nov (Anadolu via A News). IOM reported more than 5,000 people fleeing villages in North Darfur on 10–11 Nov. Repeated mass-casualty attacks on civilians keep the Alert.
for_you: For travel, follow FCDO advice against all travel to Sudan. Humanitarian appeals by the UN and agencies such as WFP and UNHCR set out needs.
rubric_hit: Repeated mass-casualty attacks on civilians and sieges = Alert

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
